_readme: Single source of truth for /tools/. Edit here, run python3 tools/tools_pages.py, push. kind: free | kit | install | event. status: live | soon. A kit becomes buyable when stripeLink (https://buy.stripe.com/...) and stripePaymentLinkId (plink_...) are set and its file exists in kits/. Free tools with a file are served from /assets/downloads/. Prices are shown as written.

products.name: The founder-led sales blueprint
products.summary: Seven parts and a scorecard on getting sales out of your head and into a system that grows, holds and sells without you.
products.for: B2B founders who still close every deal themselves.
points: Seven parts, each with actions for this month
A scorecard to show where sales still depends on you
20 minutes to read end to end

products.name: Budget 2026: The Founder's Digest
products.summary: The parts of the Budget that matter to a founder-led business, in plain English, with worked examples.
products.for: UK founders planning a raise, a sale or their next hire.
points: Founders' Relief and BADR changes
British Business Bank funding lines
EMI, CSOP and wage changes

products.name: Call-to-follow-up skill
products.summary: Pulls the transcript from your call recorder, writes a clear recap and drafts the follow-up email in your own tone.
products.for: Founders who record their sales and client calls.
points: Works with Fathom, Granola or a pasted transcript
Recap document plus a ready-to-send draft
One-page set-up guide

products.name: LinkedIn profile rewrite pack
products.summary: The formula I used to rewrite my own headline and About section: credential, what the client gets, the outcome.
products.for: Founders whose profile does not yet do the selling.
points: Three headline styles
Two About section structures
Checks against LinkedIn's character limits

products.name: Newsletter story architect
products.summary: A structural edit for a finished newsletter draft, built on five story principles. It fixes the shape and leaves your voice alone.
products.for: Founders writing a regular newsletter or long post.
points: Scene opening, method after results
Room for the hard part of the story
A quiet close instead of a hard sell

products.name: Bookkeeping inbox triage
products.summary: Sorts a messy receipts inbox into what goes to your accounting software, what your bookkeeper needs to fetch and what needs your call.
products.for: Founders running more than one company or a cluttered finance inbox.
points: Routes by entity
Flags duplicates and missing PDFs
Nothing is forwarded without you

products.name: Discovery Call Prep kit
products.summary: Researches the prospect before the call: company, founder, competitors, reviews and filings. Then a brief with a fit read, the questions to ask and a pre-call message.
products.for: Founders running their own discovery calls.
points: Prospect and competitor research in minutes
Questions that diagnose before you prescribe
Set up once with your ICP and offer

products.name: Proposal Pack
products.summary: Turns a call transcript into a branded proposal, as a Word agreement or a slide deck, with phasing and firm commercials.
products.for: Founders and consultants who write proposals by hand.
points: Word agreement and slide deck versions
Your brand, your clauses, your prices
A short guide to anchoring price

products.name: First Commercial Hire kit
products.summary: Most first sales hires are set up to fail. This gives them a system to inherit and you a 30/60/90 plan both of you sign.
products.for: Founders about to hire their first salesperson.
points: 30/60/90 plan with ramped targets
A business plan the new hire writes
Matching slide deck for the kick-off

products.name: Voice Writer kit
products.summary: Dictate a voice note, get a newsletter or LinkedIn post that sounds like you wrote it. Starts by learning your voice from your own posts.
products.for: Founders who have plenty to say and no time to write it.
points: Builds your voice file from 5 to 10 posts
Newsletter and LinkedIn formats
Keeps your rhythm, not AI filler

products.name: AI Chief of Staff
products.summary: A brief waiting on your phone every morning: today's meetings, replies you owe, deals at risk, leads to chase, and a prep doc for every sales call.
points: Reads your calendar, email, Slack and call notes
Prep doc for every new business meeting
Read-only by default, set up with you

products.name: The CRM you never update
products.summary: A simple deal board that updates itself each week from your email, calendar, calls and LinkedIn. It replaced HubSpot in my own business.
products.for: Founders who gave up on their CRM.
points: Kanban board on your own website
Weekly sweep with evidence for every change
Your edits always win

products.name: Newsletter Engine
products.summary: Dictate the story, approve one draft, and the letter goes out on email, LinkedIn, Substack and your website without you touching it again.
products.for: Founders who want one weekly letter on every channel.
points: Your voice, your format, your brand
Nothing sends until you say go
Four channels from one approval

products.name: Run your business on Claude
products.summary: A live session where I show the whole set-up running in my own business, and how to start on yours.
products.for: Founders who want to see it working before they build it.
points: Live demos, not slides
What to build first and what to skip
The guardrails that keep it safe
